page_title: ROM 2-0 VER | AS Roma v Verona 28/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes a short corner kick.
90+7' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Verona due to a handball in the build-up play.
90+6' The Verona players halt their celebrations as referee Ermano Feliciani makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90+5' Gift Orban (Verona) puts the ball in the back of the net!
90+1' Rafik Belghali (Verona) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Ermano Feliciani's book.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Antoine Bernede walks off.
88' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

88' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
87' Fallou Cham (Verona) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Ermano Feliciani saw the whole situation.
87' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Lorenzo Montipo's superb save the ball would have probably ended up in the bottom left corner.
86' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

86' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Lorenzo Montipo anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
84' Substitution. Domagoj Bradaric makes way for Fallou Cham (Verona).
84' Paolo Zanetti has decided to make a change. Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona) replaces Unai Nunez.
83' Gift Orban (Verona) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
83' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for a foul.
82' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Matias Soule as he is replaced by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
79' 2 - 0 Goal! Matias Soule (AS Roma) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
78' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Martin Frese (Verona).
78' Amin Sarr (Verona) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
75' The resulting corner from Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

75' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The ball goes out for a corner. AS Roma can continue in their attacking effort.
74' Rafik Belghali (Verona) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
74' Paolo Zanetti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Amin Sarr (Verona) replacing Giovane.
71' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Evan Ndicka walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jan Ziolkowski (AS Roma).

70' Antoine Bernede (Verona) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Mile Svilar, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
68' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for a foul.
68' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Domagoj Bradaric (Verona).
67' Gift Orban (Verona) dribbles into the box, but Mile Svilar is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.

67' Rafik Belghali (Verona) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Mile Svilar has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
65' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
64' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
60' Here comes a substitution. Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) is brought on as a substitute for Artem Dovbyk.
59' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Angelino will be replaced by Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma).
59' Substitution. Wesley Franca leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mario Hermoso (AS Roma).
53' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
51' Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle and it's Giovane (Verona) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
48' Giovane (Verona) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
47' Suat Serdar (Verona) tries to threaten the goalkeeper as he takes the ball and fires from long range. The shot flies just over the crossbar!
46' Substitution. Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) replaces Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro.
46' Referee Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Good movement by Matias Soule (AS Roma), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Unai Nunez (Verona) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
45' Matias Soule (AS Roma) plays a lovely through ball to Wesley Franca, but he can't beat Lorenzo Montipo and loses the ball.
40' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
39' Ermano Feliciani blows the whistle, Martin Frese (Verona) is penalised for a foul.
37' Martin Frese (Verona) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Mile Svilar.
37' Ermano Feliciani blows for a foul after Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
36' Some patient build-up play from AS Roma as they look to unlock the defence.
33' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
31' Rafik Belghali (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but Mile Svilar comes off his line to gather the ball.
30' Manu Kone (AS Roma) commits a rough foul. Ermano Feliciani stops the game and makes a call.
29' Half-chance! Giovane (Verona) plays a pass into the box, but Mile Svilar reacts well to snuff out the attack.

28' OFF THE BAR! Gift Orban (Verona) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the crossbar! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
28' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Lorenzo Montipo comes off the line to clear the ball away.
26' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lorenzo Montipo intercepts the ball.
26' The corner from Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is cleared away by the defence.
25' Matias Soule (AS Roma) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
23' Martin Frese (Verona) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The linesman signals a throw-in for AS Roma.
22' Rafik Belghali (Verona) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.

19' Close! Gift Orban (Verona) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
19' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
18' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Ermano Feliciani stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
17' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
16' The corner from Martin Frese (Verona) is intercepted by the defence.

15' Gift Orban (Verona) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the left post. Mile Svilar guesses his intentions and denies him with a fine save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Verona.
12' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona) receives a yellow card.
11' Manu Kone (AS Roma) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
10' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
7' 1 - 0 Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the right post. Excellent finish.
6' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the corner with a short pass.
6' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. AS Roma have a corner.
6' Angelino (AS Roma) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. AS Roma force a corner. They send men into the box.
4' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
4' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. AS Roma get a corner.
3' A cross from Rafik Belghali (Verona) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
AS Roma will kick the game off.
Ermano Feliciani will supervise the game today.
